maintenance_items.description: Use VW 507.00 approved oil (5W30). This engine is sensitive to incorrect oil specification.
The 1.6 TDI uses a belt, not a chain. Change interval is 210k km per VW spec. Replace water pump at the same time.
The 1.6 TDI DPF tends to clog earlier in city driving. Consider forced regeneration if warning appears.

maintenance_items.label: AdBlue / DEF refill
maintenance_items.description: The SCR system consumes AdBlue. Refill at each service or when warning appears.
